text.p: A landslide triggered by heavy rain in China's southwestern province of Sichuan has killed 48 people and injured 29 after sweeping away a crowded building, state radio said on Friday.
A sudden rainstorm that pounded Sichuan's Jiuqing township on Thursday afternoon triggered the landslide, which slammed into the building, killing all 48 people inside, the radio said.
"All the people inside who were taking shelter from the rain were killed," the radio said.
Local officials reached by telephone declined to comment.
A further 29 people were injured by the landslide, the radio said, but gave no details of where they were or the extent of their injuries.
Disaster relief teams had rushed to the site and were carrying out rescue operations, it said.

A landslide in southwestern Guizhou province killed 31 and injured five on Monday, and floods have killed at least 110 people in eastern and southern China this month, officials and state media have said.
